我的生活与旅行(My Life and travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:莉莉与杰克的经历和小计划。
Lily borrowed a book about science from the bookstore. Lily drinks milk after doing sports. Lily and Jack had great fun there. The travel agency fixed the whole route.
Lily learned a lot about science. Lily thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like chicken and milk. What's more, the travel brochure oversold the beach.
They took many photos at the train station. Lily likes rainy days best. Last Sunday, Lily and Jack went to the airport. Off-peak tickets cost half price.
Jack is interested in dancing. Life is full of small surprises. It takes twenty minutes to get to the airport by bike.
